run_cwm_debugger_cli: run the CWM debugger CLI to step through Python source code with an LLM model
create_cwm_debugger_instance: create a CWMDebugger instance with source code, tokenizer, host, port, and temperature settings
step_through_code: step through code line by line using the CWMDebugger step method to enter functions
step_over_functions: step over function calls using the CWMDebugger next method to advance to the next line
inspect_local_variables: inspect local variables at the current frame using the CWMDebugger local_vars property
